title: apply_content_patch does not enforce the closed op vocabulary at the protocol boundary, and its designed PATCH_INVALID report is dead
body:
Deferred from the 2026-08-28/29 audit fix pass. The finding was confirmed by an
adversarial verifier; it was not fixed in that pass for the reason below, which is
the fixing agent's own account after reading the code.

src/mcp/server.ts (~2270-2292) types ops as `z.array(z.record(z.string(), z.unknown()))`, so the whitelist is unenforced at the MCP input schema; src/mcp/tools.ts:891 then uses a throwing `ContentPatchProposalSchema.parse`, so applyContentPatch's PATCH_INVALID branch is unreachable on the only production path and a rejected op reaches the client as a raw Zod message instead of the promised validation report. Both files are the MCP owner's.
